verdict.rationale: Google Drive has a documented public REST API (v3). The reference covers files, permissions and changes, with guides for uploads (simple, multipart, resumable), search/list, custom properties, sharing roles, push notifications and OAuth scopes, plus a machine-readable Discovery document. Community reports of rclone pulling and pushing Drive content indirectly corroborate that the product can be driven programmatically. missing for 10: direct independent hands-on corroboration of the API itself, and AI-oriented discovery artifacts (the probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec at standard paths).
